title: Memory
sub: Write facts across conversations, recall the relevant ones, forget on request.

steps.d:
"Owns a Halvorsen DW-300, purchased 2024-03-15."
"The DW-300 is in a rental property."
"Prefers email for service updates."
"Also owns a DR-520 dryer, purchased 2025-01-10."

steps.h: Your code writes every fact to memory
Your code forgets nothing this time (a later question forgets m1)
Your code recalls whichever memories are relevant to the new question
steps.d:
"Is my dishwasher still covered under warranty?"
m1 (rental property)   0.26
m0 (DW-300 purchase)   0.25
m3 (DR-520 purchase)   0.19

steps.h: The model answers once, from the recalled memories
steps.d:
"Based on the rental-property use, coverage is
limited to 90 days from purchase, which has passed."
